Persistence sits below the 900px fold on desktop (docHeight 1119) and is reachable by normal scrolling.

responsive.notes: The accessibility trees are identical across all viewports. All sections show in each full screenshot with no horizontal overflow.

obligations.obligation: blocked action remains explained and navigable
obligations.evidence: 'Confirm root cause' is disabled (disabled=true, aria-disabled=true) in line with confirm-root-cause: illegal. An adjacent visible status explains it: 'Unavailable: unresolved information is blocking progress.' This is supported by blocking-unknown-exists. Probe 001 on 'Go to blocking unknown' moved focus onto the 'Unresolved unknowns' section (after.focused = section 'Unresolved unknowns ... BLOCKER Required information is unresolved'). No scroll was needed because the section was already in the viewport (probe-001.viewport.png).

responsive.notes: The disabled button, reason text and 'Go to blocking unknown' button appear in every aria tree and screenshot. Operability was verified by the probe at desktop only.

evidenceLimitations: The explanation is a visible adjacent status, not programmatically tied to the button (describedByText is empty), but the rules do not require that link. Probe 001 moved focus without changing scroll, so landing was confirmed by focus alone, and no visible focus indicator is apparent in probe-001.viewport.png. There were no probes at non-desktop viewports. The copy stays generic ('a current explanation', 'Remote write'), which fits the predicates without adding domain facts.
